text:
ash: Quick sync — server team is launching a tiny canary for a structured routing header: `X-RI-Route-Broker` (JSON). Need SDK owners to add an opt-in path.

ben: Is this additive or replacement for `Route-Hint`?

ash: Additive. Broker preferred when present; fall back to legacy `Route-Hint`.

tia: SDK plan: expose `enable_route_broker` default false + parameter `route_broker` that accepts string|object. If string, coerce to {\"route\": <string> } and send legacy header alongside during canary.

ben: Good. Emit telemetry `sdk.route_broker.sent` and `sdk.route_broker.coerced` when coercion happens so console can measure. Include a stable per-install `client_id` in payload (opaque).

ops-bot: Console: we'll add a small "Broker adoption" gauge and a quota delta comparison. Need telemetry mapping this week.

ash: Server will provide `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` (internal) that echoes parsed payload for debugging.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: route-broker v0.1-canary -> infra-canary at 03:30 UTC. Canary: 5% traffic, 14 days. Rollback if 5xx > 1.8x or quota mismatch > 3% in first 15m.

tia: Semver: minor bumps only. I'll open py/ts/go PRs with tests, examples, changelog. Add env var `REDWOOD_ENABLE_ROUTE_BROKER` for quick opt-in.

ash: Action items: tia -> SDK PRs, ben -> migration doc + runbook, ops-bot -> telemetry mapping. Keep changes minimal. :thumbsup:

ben: ack

(End)
